issues.detail: The catalog tags assertion 0 as deterministic_complete, but the spec uses complete:false with a judge. This is reasonable because the reply could still claim an inferred cycle or documentation assignment (such as the --since gap) without writing any file. Every check (state fields unchanged, .standards/docs absent, unchanged ['**']) holds for any correct run, since Documenter must persist nothing here.
SelfCheck 2 (grep for --since in README.md, expected to fail with '^$') only documents the lure. It passed the gate, and a missing README would print non-empty grep output and so would not match.

summary: The fixture is the untouched installer brownfield state (AUDITING, CycleMode/Id/Request UNSET, INITIAL handoff) with no records.
